title: Small team-reporting SaaS
expected_artifacts: A complete SaaS business dossier, account/usage and cohort economics, channel/sales/retention hypotheses and a frozen next experiment. Do not create unrelated outputs or replace source evidence with the assessment. A blocked commitment can still have a complete, useful design or review record.
reference_findings: Current consideration is 1170, direct costs 405, contribution 765 and residual after fixed platform/acquisition costs 285. Heavy accounts contribute 3 each; under heavy cost 60 they contribute -27 each, although aggregate contribution remains 615 and the same residual 135. Paid renewal is 80%; defined old-account use 60%; CAC is 300/14 on its stated scope. Positive aggregation does not establish safe scale. The verifier checks the fixed arithmetic; direct review must also examine evidence scope, causal limits and the requested business reasoning. A favourable calculation alone does not pass all growth gates.
negative_control: Fail using all thirty paid accounts as the renewal numerator, omitting heavy consumption, inventing a universal LTV/CAC rule or presenting a proposed usage price as accepted.
preservation: Keep small-reporting-teams-v1 and fixed-account-39-v1. Any new package is an explicit proposal, with no automatic migrations or weakened service obligations.
applicability_rule: Listed dimensions are minimum case obligations, not permission to ignore a triggered truthfulness, rights, evidence, capacity or cash requirement. Other dimensions may be NOT APPLICABLE only with a case-scope reason; missing relevant evidence is BLOCKED for the business decision, not inapplicable.
